Episode 247. Liberation War of Lafrarosa (2)
In the middle of the red desert, tainted by the Red Plutonian’s energy waves, only the area where the storm of chaos spread was darkened.
"Sister, please take care of the device."
"Okay!"
As Yona disappeared somewhere, Murakan transformed into his true form, spreading his wings.
[Well, compared to the Evil God War, this is nothing. Shall we make a way first?]
[The one who was about to vomit from motion sickness now tries to act cool.]
[Just keep your comments to yourself and follow, Immortal One.]
"Friends, that's the primal chaos. So be a little careful, got it?"
Murakan and Bale soared into the sky and charged forward.
Soon after, the two of them unleashed their breath towards the black storm, shooting a massive golden beam, leaving Belize in awe.
"Well, I guess I was overly worried. In some ways, Murakan and Bale might be better suited to face the original chaos than we are."
Each time the breath and beam struck the storm's exterior, a brief, messy disturbance formed.
Even when the black storm briefly parted, it did not reveal what was happening inside. Only a pitch-black landscape was visible.
However, the group did not slow down their approach to the storm. They felt confident in handling whatever was inside, and above all, their determination to protect their comrades was strong.
The Battle Kings were emitting their wave energy.
Radiating from Jin as the center, the wave energy spiraled around the group. In the center of the vortex, a core-like golden lightning bolt enhanced the wave energy of the other comrades.
[Kid, are you going straight in?]
Jin nodded in agreement.
The deployment was not just for the purpose of launching the liberation device.
There was a need to warn and retaliate. To show what happens when they constantly try to harm Lafrarosa.

'So far, because you guys felt it was burdensome to face us head-on in this situation, most of the battles were confined to the desert. Despite having overwhelming mobility and an army. But now that you've brought in the original chaos, neither of us has a way out.'
The attacks of Murakan and Bale once again shattered the side of the black storm.
At that moment, the blue whirlwind of Jin and the Kings collided with the opening in the storm.
Grrraaaahh-!
At the moment of impact, the storm produced not a normal explosion but a roar like a person or beast wailing.
The storm crumpled at the collision point, while the wave energy viciously expanded even more in reaction.
I had expected we could break through... but this easily?"
"It must be thanks to the power Jin brother acquired upon reaching Genesis rank. Even the original chaos seems unable to gain the upper hand against Jin brother’s wave energy."
The black storm continued to scream.

Now the whirl of energy turned completely golden, looking exactly like a small sun. Shortly after, that sun quickly converged into Sigmund, and at the same time, Jin's body transformed like a bright white flame.
The sword flashed.
When a streak of lightning formed inside the crack of the black storm, the dark scene was ripped apart.
The sword mark remained for a while, preventing the crack in the black storm from closing.
It felt as if not a sword's energy, but a massive structure suppressing the land was installed. Even the scattered golden energy particles were devouring the particles of chaos.
Both Murakan and Bale, who looked down on the scene from the sky, and the fighting kings standing right next to Jin, were shocked by the sword.
[Wow, kid. You really hit the jackpot.]
"But Jin brother, as much as you've grown stronger, it's hard to keep up like this."
"Teto brother has big dreams and never bends to them, which I really like."
"Cheh! Who says I can't become Genesis one day?"
"There isn't, but there is."
"What does that mean!"
The golden sword mark left by Jin was shocking to others in the desert. The Red Plutonian, the demon trio, and even the forces of Zipple that had just arrived on the opposite side of Jin.
"Vamel coalition forces, identification complete!"
"It's the Black Dragon Murakan! Murakan has left Tikan...!"
The Red Plutonians inside the Pibil were shouting.
Shimat squinted his eyes, staring intently at the golden sword mark opened on the other side of the storm of chaos.
"...Bringing Murakan, quite a risky gamble."
If the Red Plutonian immediately moves all its forces to Tikan and the Garden of the Sword, the Vamel alliance will suffer irreparable damage.
‘The fact that Murakan is here means one of two things. Either they are certain they can liberate Lafrarosa right now, or they are certain that this chaos is deadly to Lafrarosa.’
The latter seemed more likely.
"Bother Limagas."
{Speak, God Brother}
"First, check if spatial leap is possible."
{I just checked. It's impossible. The witch's chaos strongly interferes with the formation of the portal. If we fly out of the desert, it should be possible.}
"Then the intentions of Lokia Ganesto are clear. They want us to fight within this chaos, not thinking about attacking their main base. This must be the price for borrowing the witch's power."
The Red Plutonian has a lower resistance to chaos than the Blue Plutonian.
Even in this original chaos, where even the Plutonian is not completely immune, the lower-ranked Red Plutonian fighters couldn't survive.
The protection of the airborne fortress and ships also had its limits. Especially since the Vamel Alliance wasn't just sitting around.
{...Yes. The lives claimed by the chaos will likely be bound to the witch.}
"It's a decent price to pay to get rid of Lafrarosa. Let's finish it this time. It will be our last long battle in the desert."
At that moment, another flash of golden sword energy shone from the storm where Jin's group was.
The dark winds rushing at them were being pushed back by that sword energy. Jin's body was still burning brightly, and the fierce glint in the kings' eyes turned toward the battlefield.
Between the Vamel Alliance and the Red Plutonian, a rift from Lafrarosa, larger than ever, opened up.
Chaos poured into that rift like a tidal wave. Occasionally, deep blue lightning shot out, pushing back the chaos.
That was Vahn's blade energy. Until now, she had only dealt with cannon fire and magic, but now she had to fend off this original chaos.
It felt like blood was rushing in reverse.

Jin and his brothers immediately recognized that Vahn's sword energy was different from usual. Although it had always maintained its intrinsic destructive power even after passing through dimensions, it was now wild and unstable.
This was because Ling Ling was affected by the original chaos.
"Bale, search for any nearby Ganesto. And while you're at it, look for an opportunity to throw the device with Yona."
Unlike usual, Bale nodded without a word. The refined killing intent radiating from Jin seemed to freeze even the nearby flow of chaos.
The area where Jin's group stood looked like a bizarre landscape where time had stopped. For a while, Jin read all types of energies mixed within the chaos.
First, he felt the weary breaths of Vahn and Ling Ling, and the groans of his brothers.
He also felt the cold gaze of Shimat, probably watching him from the ship's bridge, and the group of mages from Zipple, trying to penetrate the chaos from a distance.
This time, he didn't sense the presence of Elona Zipple.
'Zipple didn't send Lady Elona because the original chaos could unpredictably affect her mind control. In that case... You should have refrained from sending your forces, Kelliark Zipple.'
Jin's body gradually regained its original color.
All the anger and resentment about the situation seemed to have condensed into a single droplet of blood, crystallizing in his eyes.
It was time to fight with a clear mind. At least until they could confirm exactly how the "original chaos" was affecting Vahn, Lingling, and the brothers.

This was due to Lingling's unique nature. If the original chaos was directly interfering with Lingling across dimensions, then, conversely, Lingling's power could manifest directly in the battlefield.
This meant that, unlike before,it might be possible to achieve a union with Battle God.
"A lot depends on Lingling."
"Really? Brother Jin. Then that's fortunate. Sister Vahn adores that little one. She will live up to the expectations."
"But we can't just wait for that little one. Not because I don't trust her, but because it would be a burden on her."
Jin raised his sword high. Suddenly, as the chaos that had stopped began to burn and evaporate, a space opened up.
Simultaneously, red lights gathered on the canons of the Red Plutonian's fleet. The main guns of four air fortresses were all aimed at Jin and his party.
Before swinging his raised sword, Jin first dropped golden thunderbolts across the battlefield. Suddenly, hundreds of thunderbolts poured down from the pitch-black sky without any warning or gesture.
The moment the thunderbolts touched the Red Plutonian's protective shield, the air fortresses and fleet began their attacks. Huge red beams poured down over the heads of the group.
[Did you think that would be enough when I'm here?]

Murakan descended in front of the group, spreading a curtain of spiritual energy. It wasn't just a simple shield. Some of the beams that collided with the fluctuating spirit energy disappeared or were reflected.
The Fighting Kings repelled the enemy wave energy that escaped the curtain, roaring fiercely. The falling thunderbolts also continuously hammered the air fortresses' main guns.
As these immense forces collided between the group and the Red Plutonian, Jin finally swung his sword downward.
Runcandel's third decisive technique, Meteor Shower. Meteors formed by the lightning bolts began to pierce down from the sky like ambushing dragons.

The enemy tribe naturally thought the Meteor Shower would hit their fleet and increased the output applied to their shields. As a result, Murakan and the Fighting Kings gained the upper hand in the power struggle.
"First, let's get rid of the small fries that don't fit this battlefield, brothers."
"Sounds good."
"I was wondering why they even came."
Small fries.
Pawns.
The mages from the Zipple group who dared to come to the desert without even a commander-level figure.
The meteors that Jin dropped were heading towards them. And the sword that Jin had thrust into the ground was forming another family's decisive technique.
"This time, we might get a little hurt at most, but you lot... will witness many deaths..."
Runcandel's first decisive technique, the Sky Splitter (쇄천의), surged, splitting the desert.
